note: Phase 2, measurement B for the local-layer plan (M3a, M10): layers with pointers. The system prompt carries an index, one line per topic with an opaque pointer; each topic's notes (the details) are held by the script, as Auster's layer would hold them. Each question's answer is only in one topic's notes; three topics have no question. All names, places and facts are invented. kind and want are graded by scripts/phase-1/quiz.py; every question carries its tail.
header: The household keeps notes on these topics. Only this index is shown here: each topic's notes are kept separately, under the pointer in square brackets.

topics.name: The car
notes: The front tyres take 39 psi and the rear tyres 35 psi.
The car is serviced at Fernley Motors.
The MOT is due in March.
The car takes 5W-30 oil.

topics.name: The family holiday
topics.gloss: the cottage, the ferry and packing
notes: The ferry leaves at 9:40 on the first morning.
Check-in at the cottage is from 16:00.
The cottage sleeps six.
We bring our own towels.

topics.name: Nell's swimming
notes: Lessons are on Saturdays.
She needs goggles and an orange swimming cap.
The lockers take a one-pound coin.
Her next badge is Stage 5.

topics.name: Ivo's school
topics.gloss: PE days, the class teacher and trips
notes: PE is on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
His class teacher is Mrs Brightwell.
The school trip on 4 December costs 14 pounds.
Lunch money goes in on Mondays.

topics.name: The dog
notes: The vet is Dr Fairweather.
The dog is wormed every six weeks.
He gets two scoops of dry food at breakfast.
His lead hangs by the back door.

topics.name: The garden
topics.gloss: the lawn, the shed and the vegetables
notes: The lawn is mowed every other week.
The hose is in the shed.
The tomatoes are fed on Sundays.
The compost bin is behind the greenhouse.

topics.name: Grandma Hester's visit
topics.gloss: her train, her room and her meals
notes: She arrives on the 14:52 train.
She has the ground-floor room.
She does not eat mushrooms.
She stays until Tuesday.

topics.name: The boiler and heating
topics.gloss: the timer, the pressure gauge and the service
notes: The heating runs from 6:30 to 8:30 and from 17:00 to 22:00.
The pressure gauge should read 1.3 bar.
The boiler is serviced every January.
The thermostat is in the hall.

topics.name: Bins and recycling
topics.gloss: collection days and what goes where
notes: The green bin goes out on Tuesdays.
The glass box goes out every other Friday.
Used batteries go to the library.
Cardboard is flattened and goes in the blue bag.

topics.name: Mum's book club
topics.gloss: dates, the book and who is hosting
notes: It meets on the first Thursday of the month.
This month's book is The Lantern Weir.
This month it meets at Mrs Thistlewood's house.
Everyone brings a dessert.

topics.name: Ivo's birthday party
topics.gloss: the guests, the venue and the cake
notes: Eight guests are invited.
It is at the climbing wall at 14:00 on 6 December.
The cake is ordered from Hollins.
The theme is dinosaurs.

topics.name: Internet and devices
topics.gloss: the router, the printer and the tablets
notes: The router is under the stairs.
The printer takes cartridge 47B.
The children's tablets switch off at 19:30.
The smart speaker is in the kitchen.

topics.name: Cleaning
notes: Ivo hoovers on Saturdays.
Nell dusts the living room.
Spare bin bags are under the sink.

topics.name: The allotment
topics.gloss: the plot, its key and watering
notes: The plot is number 17.
The gate key hangs on the hook by the fridge.
We water from the butt, not the tap.

topics.name: Dad's cycling
topics.gloss: the bike, its shop and the rides
notes: The bike is serviced at Spokesmith.
The Saturday ride leaves at 8:00.
Spare inner tubes are in the garage.
